facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; you never have to convert foreign earnings to pesos.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer foreign-currency deposit accounts (FCDUs).
facts.P3_local_gateways: PayMongo takes unregistered sellers for QR Ph only; cards and GCash need DTI registration.
facts.L1_registration: Register with BIR (Form 1901, online via ORUS); DTI only for a business name.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the BIR, issued when you register with Form 1901.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Taxed on worldwide income; under ₱3m sales, choose 8% on receipts above ₱250,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: VAT only above ₱3m a year; services paid in foreign currency are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Privacy Act 2012, enforced by the National Privacy Commission.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Internet Transactions Act 2023 covers online sellers; DTI runs an E-Commerce Bureau.
facts.L7_incentives: The 8% flat tax option, and zero VAT on foreign-currency services.
facts.D1_id_document: PhilID (national ID), or its digital ePhilID.

watch_out.text: All online sellers must register with BIR, whatever their size.
Choose the 8% option at registration or on your first quarterly return.
